tag_note: every count and percentile is computed by sonic/make_sonic_table.py from the per-tick logs in results/sonic/raw/; falls from each run's simulator record (resets and fall flags); the Fisher p-values are DERIVED
same_span: same upstream program (gear_sonic_deploy g1_deploy_onnx_ref @ b042411), same measurement probe, same step span, same fixed keyboard script and the same scoring code on every machine; only the computer (and its TensorRT build) differs

rules.step: obs_start -> after CurrentFrameAdvancement (whole 50 Hz control step)
rules.fall_rule_window: pelvis z < 0.30 m OR tilt > 60 deg OR a sim fall-reset, inside [band_off + 1 s, stop)
rules.band_drop_fall: a sim fall-reset within 3 s after the band-off command (a reset later than +1.0 s is counted in both columns)
rules.tracking: per-phase mean joint error within +/-30% of the RTX 5090 v1_r1-r3 range, displacement +/-15%, turn yaw +/-15 deg
